name: 连续性方程（管道变径）计算器

map.由入口断面、流速与出口断面，按 A₁v₁ = A₂v₂ 求变径后流速。: Apply A1v1 = A2v2 to find the velocity after a pipe diameter change from the inlet area/velocity and the outlet area.
map.不可压定常流：体积流量守恒 Q=A·v = 常数。: Incompressible steady flow: volumetric flow conserved Q=A·v = const.
map.变径管按流量守恒求各段流速。: Reducer: find each section velocity by flow conservation.
map.分流汇流节点流量平衡校核。: Junction: check flow balance at split/merge nodes.
map.文丘里等装置前后流速关系。: Venturi and similar: velocity relation before/after.
map.总管 Q=0.03 分两路各 0.015，按管径配流速避免偏流。: Main Q=0.03 split into two 0.015; size velocity by diameter to avoid bias flow.
map.不可压流体体积守恒 Q=Av；可压流需计密度变，质量守恒。: Incompressible: volume Q=Av; compressible needs density change, mass conserved.
map.节点 inflow=outflow，配合各支管 Q=Av 解流速分布。: Node inflow=outflow, with each branch Q=Av to solve velocity distribution.
